name: Pathways to Possibilities (Proper Job Theatre Company)
whoFor: Economically inactive Kirklees residents aged 18+, particularly people with health conditions or disabilities, who want to build skills and confidence and take a next step into learning, volunteering or work.
eligibility: Has the right to live and work in the UK
Economically inactive (of working age), particularly with health conditions or disabilities
exclusions: None specified - if the Trailblazer element is not suitable, the person will be supported via the most appropriate alternative option
referralRoutes: Email the delivery partner programme address (to be confirmed)

projects.name: Pathways to Possibilities
projects.overview: Three strands: health and wellbeing (confidence, resilience, social connections); engaging and building confidence for learning; and preparation for employment. Connects people to volunteering, learning and employment opportunities. 50 places available.
projects.duration: Programme starts 1 September 2026; referrals close 1 March 2027. No fixed duration - flexible and person-centred
where: Proper Job Theatre Company Ltd, 46/47 Byram Arcade, Westgate, Huddersfield HD1 1ND
Remote support (a mix of face-to-face and remote)

workExperience: Yes - volunteering and work experience opportunities
notes:
Webpage and self-referral route still to be confirmed in the source document.

Status before November 2026: Live - open to referrals
